data.narrative:
Thunder Tiger, a defense and security company founded by Chun Lin Lai, operates within a sector containing 26 peer companies. The valuation universe includes 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, with top-tier private comparables including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI. Thunder Tiger has raised $22M+ as of 2025.

The peer-median triangulation method proved inapplicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security sector, while containing 26 same-sector peers, lacks sufficient narrow-stage comparables to support a reliable median benchmark. The filter for same-stage peers yielded only 1 datapoint, with 0 adjacent-stage and 0 similar-tier comparables identified. This shortfall below the minimum 3-datapoint threshold precluded peer-median valuation. A sector-wide median would introduce substantial comparability noise given the heterogeneity in defense subsectors, company maturity, and technology focus.

Without sufficient narrow comparables, alternative triangulation methods—including revenue multiples, venture-backed funding rounds, or precedent transaction analysis—would require additional dataset inputs not provided here. Valuation range and key uncertainties cannot be responsibly synthesized from the available data. Further analysis requires either expanded peer identification within Defense & Security, introduction of revenue or margin data, or recent comparable funding rounds at defined post-money valuations to anchor the analysis.
